reviews.reason: Repeated test sends require a separate delivery purpose and normal-only uniqueness; older fanout workers use the old conflict target.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API and worker processes, apply the migration and role grants, and start only matching binaries. See docs/events.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: Collection-owned sinks and explicit grants change subscription and dispatch authorization; older writers and workers do not enforce that boundary.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API and worker processes, apply the migration and role grants, and restart matching binaries. Bind existing credential-bearing webhooks to their destinations. See docs/events.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: Older API and worker replicas do not enforce interactive credential kinds, family revocation, and refresh rotation. The authentication contract requires a coordinated upgrade.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop older API and worker replicas, apply the session/activity migration and role grants, then start matching binaries and upgrade frontend/SDK consumers. Clear existing BFF sessions and sign in again. See docs/auth_model.md#interactive-sessions.

reviews.reason: Older restore executors cannot preserve the new logical identity evidence; identity initialization and history indexes require a coordinated upgrade.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop older API and worker replicas, back up the database, reapply generated setup/grants SQL as the database administrator for split roles, run hubuum-admin --migrate to completion including resumable identity backfill, then start matching binaries. Retain the pre-upgrade snapshot for rollback. See docs/logical_identity.md#upgrade-and-backup-compatibility.

reviews.reason: Shared admission, execution occupancy and restore reconciliation require every writer and worker to use the same persisted policy and control generation.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop API and worker replicas, back up the database, run hubuum-admin --migrate through identity and capacity backfill, reconcile role grants, then start matching binaries. Existing per-kind settings seed the shared policy once; use the administrator task-capacity endpoint for subsequent changes. See docs/task_admission.md.

reviews.reason: Artifact-backed task outputs, physical reservations and portable backup format 12 require matching writers, readers and restore executors. The widened limits preserve retained artifacts independently of write policy.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop API and worker processes, back up the database, run hubuum-admin --migrate and reconcile grants, then start matching binaries. Reclaim all artifact-backed output and cleanup obligations before downgrading. See docs/artifact_staging.md#backup-restore-and-upgrades.

reviews.reason: The control check preserves every format-1 predicate while admitting format 2 with bound managed-copy receipts. Runtime registration is new; older runtimes cannot participate in its quiescence proof, so initial activation requires an offline upgrade.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop every older API and worker process before applying migrations and runtime role grants, then start only matching binaries. Keep the independent control repository outside primary rollback boundaries. See docs/deletion_recovery.md.

reviews.reason: Application-incarnation permits, exact runtime drain acknowledgements, restore reapplication and persisted task-claim fences require every producer to use the new protocol. Older binaries cannot establish process isolation or prevent stale publication.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop every older API, worker, restore executor and administrator producer; apply the migration and reconcile runtime grants; configure the independent repository on every producer and start matching binaries. Preserve all existing runtime registrations and recovery material. See docs/deletion_recovery.md#upgrade-and-rollback.

reviews.reason: The existing control predicates remain intact while format 3 adds required protected lifecycle audit evidence. Older producers cannot preserve it or enforce audit-before-acknowledgement ordering.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop every older API, worker, restore executor and administrator producer; migrate and reconcile grants, then deploy matching binaries. Retain the independent repository and key. Downgrade refuses retained format-3 evidence. See docs/deletion_recovery.md#protected-audit-evidence.

reviews.reason: Durable class/principal scheduling, worker availability and hard reservations require matching claim contracts across every worker; the queue index is built offline.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop API and worker replicas, back up the database, run hubuum-admin --migrate and reconcile role grants, then start only matching binaries. Include scheduling in administrator policy updates. See docs/task_scheduling.md.

reviews.reason: Protected stable-principal task receipts replace task-row lifetime uniqueness. Every producer must reserve and protect an exact generation before execution; older writers cannot preserve receipt windows, scoped purge fences or restored deduplication authority. The legacy-only partial index keeps uniqueness while receipt protection is disabled or legacy rows await backfill.
reviews.upgrade_action: Stop all older API, worker, restore executor and administrator producers; apply this migration and reconcile runtime grants; deploy matching binaries with the independent repository configured. Preview and explicitly enable finite legacy deduplication, repeat bounded backfill to completion, and verify the activation checkpoint before starting protected producers. Preserve original terminal clocks and grandfather old task details. See docs/task_retention.md#upgrade-and-activation.
